summary: Removes a doubly-linked-list node (a2) from a list owned by this. Reads the node's prev pointer at node+436 (0x1B4) and, when non-null, writes the node's next pointer (node+440) into prev+440; reads the node's next pointer at node+440 (0x1B8) and, when non-null, writes the node's prev pointer (node+436) into next+436. When the removed node is the current head (this[62] == a2, i.e. this+0xF8), the head advances to node->next and that new head becomes the return value; otherwise returns a2.
